threads_inbox_sort_idx.name: threads_inbox_sort_idx
threads_inbox_sort_idx.where: "threads"."folder" = 'inbox' and not "threads"."screening" and "threads"."muted_at" is null and "threads"."message_count" > 0

threads_inbox_unread_idx.name: threads_inbox_unread_idx
threads_inbox_unread_idx.where: "threads"."folder" = 'inbox' and "threads"."unread" and not "threads"."screening" and "threads"."muted_at" is null and "threads"."message_count" > 0
